reports.title: Cameco (TSX: CCO; NYSE: CCJ) today reported its consolidated financial and operating results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).

guidance.heading: 2026 OUTLOOK UPDATE
section: • | Production: We have narrowed our guidance for our expected share of production of U3O8 to be between 19.5 million and 20.5 million pounds (previously 19.5 million to 21.5 million pounds) for 2026, reflecting greater certainty in the timing of uranium production as we approach the end of the year.

• | Sales/delivery volumes: We have narrowed our guidance for the sales/deliveries volumes in our uranium segment to 29.5 to 30.5 million pounds (previously 29 to 32 million pounds) as we have greater confidence in the timing of potential uranium deliveries as we approach the end of the year.

• | Financial metrics: We have updated our guidance for average unit cost of sales, direct administration costs and capital expenditures. See 2026 Outlook in our third quarter MD&A for more information.
